formal_statement:
theorem TrotterError.errorOrderCond_iff [NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra ℚ 𝔸]
    [CompleteSpace 𝔸] (p : ℕ) (H : Fin Γ → 𝔸) :
    List.TFAE [P.IsOrderOf p H,
      (fun τ => ‖additiveKernel P H τ‖) =O[𝓝 (0 : ℝ)] (fun τ => τ ^ p),
      (fun τ => ‖exponentiatedError P H τ‖) =O[𝓝 (0 : ℝ)] (fun τ => τ ^ p),
      (fun t => ‖multiplicativeError P H t‖) =O[𝓝 (0 : ℝ)] (fun t => t ^ (p + 1))] := by sorry
